entries.sql:
CREATE TABLE ticket0_agent_profiles (
  principal TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  avatar_url TEXT,
  signature TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE ticket0_ai_turns (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ticket0_conversations(id),
  message_id TEXT,
  model TEXT NOT NULL,
  input_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL,
  output_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL,
  cited_article_ids TEXT NOT NULL,
  confidence INTEGER,
  outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('drafted','answered','escalated','failed')),
  meter_entry_id TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE ticket0_contacts (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  external_id TEXT,
  principal TEXT,
  email TEXT,
  display_name TEXT,
  verified_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (external_id)
);

CREATE TABLE ticket0_conversation_tags (
  conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  tag TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (conversation_id, tag)
);

CREATE TABLE ticket0_conversations (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  contact_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ticket0_contacts(id),
  channel TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (channel IN ('widget','email')),
  subject TEXT NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('new','open','snoozed','resolved','closed')),
  assignee TEXT,
  priority TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (priority IN ('low','normal','urgent')),
  snoozed_until TEXT,
  first_public_reply_at TEXT,
  resolved_at TEXT,
  merged_into TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE ticket0_csat (
  conversation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  score INTEGER NOT NULL,
  comment TEXT,
  submitted_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE ticket0_desk_settings (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  from_address TEXT NOT NULL,
  greeting TEXT NOT NULL,
  allowed_origins TEXT NOT NULL,
  verification_secret TEXT NOT NULL,
  business_hours TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE ticket0_kb_articles (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  source_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  url TEXT NOT NULL,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  heading_path TEXT NOT NULL,
  body TEXT NOT NULL,
  content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  ingested_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (source_id, url)
);

CREATE TABLE ticket0_kb_sources (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('llms-txt','sitemap','markdown')),
  url TEXT NOT NULL,
  label TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('idle','ingesting','failed')),
  last_ingested_at TEXT,
  last_error TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (url)
);

CREATE TABLE ticket0_messages (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ticket0_conversations(id),
  author_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (author_kind IN ('contact','agent','assistant','system')),
  author_principal TEXT,
  visibility TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (visibility IN ('public','internal')),
  body_text TEXT NOT NULL,
  body_html TEXT,
  email_message_id TEXT,
  email_in_reply_to TEXT,
  delivered_at TEXT,
  cited_article_ids TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE ticket0_notifications (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  principal TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('assigned','replied','mentioned','snooze-woke','escalated')),
  conversation_id TEXT,
  read_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE ticket0_saved_replies (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  body TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (title)
);

CREATE TABLE ticket0_usage_rates (
  meter_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  unit_price TEXT NOT NULL,
  currency TEXT NOT NULL,
  effective_from TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (meter_key, effective_from)
);

CREATE TABLE ticket0_widget_sessions (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ticket0_conversations(id),
  contact_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  origin TEXT NOT NULL,
  token_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  last_seen_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (token_hash)
);

CREATE TABLE ticket0_widget_openings (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  contact_id TEXT,
  origin TEXT NOT NULL,
  token_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  last_seen_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (token_hash)
);
ALTER TABLE ticket0_ai_turns ADD COLUMN error TEXT;
ALTER TABLE ticket0_desk_settings ADD COLUMN assistant_autonomous INTEGER;

CREATE TABLE ticket0_signups (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('waitlist','newsletter')),
  email TEXT NOT NULL,
  note TEXT,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('pending','confirmed','unsubscribed')),
  origin TEXT NOT NULL,
  confirm_token_hash TEXT,
  unsubscribe_token TEXT NOT NULL,
  requested_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  confirmed_at TEXT,
  unsubscribed_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (kind, email)
);
ALTER TABLE ticket0_conversations ADD COLUMN follows TEXT;
ALTER TABLE ticket0_desk_settings ADD COLUMN abandoned_after_days INTEGER;

CREATE TABLE ticket0_block_rules (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('email','domain','contact')),
  value TEXT NOT NULL,
  reason TEXT,
  created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (kind, value)
);
ALTER TABLE ticket0_saved_replies ADD COLUMN actions TEXT;
